name: clearjev-router
description: Automatic pre-prompt routing for Codex CLI: Jev (TypeSafe System One) judges every prompt and switches the session to the chosen model plus reasoning effort via the local app-server. CLI chat control via $clearjev; pre-routed CLI sessions via `clearjev run`.

interface.longDescription: ClearJev adds automatic Jev routing to Codex. A UserPromptSubmit hook classifies intent, complexity, risk and repository demand via the TypeSafe Jev API, switches the thread to the chosen model and reasoning effort through the local Codex app-server, and injects a concise confirmation (model, reasoning, planning, validation) as developer context. A switch is reported only after confirmation; failures stay honest advisory output. Manage routing from Codex CLI chat with the $clearjev skill (on/off/status/models/key/autoswitch). The skill is CLI-only and refuses on other hosts; there the hook stays advisory and plain `clearjev on|off|status` messages still work hook-side. ClearJev is an independent open-source project, not affiliated with or endorsed by TypeSafe AI, Inc. Users must provide their own TypeSafe API key.
defaultPrompt: Show ClearJev status and available actions.
Turn ClearJev routing off for now.
List the models ClearJev can route to.
